name: Service Building
use: Facilities maintenance: machine and woodworking shops, paint shop, offices; three-stall fire station

facts.text: Built in 1939 for the maintenance department, machine and woodworking shops, paint shop and the superintendent of properties' office.
On College Road, sharing a site with the combined heat and power plant; known for its three-stall fire station and the smokestack behind it.

more.label: UNH Library Archives: administrative and campus life buildings

verdict: The 1939 brick facilities shops and fire bays beneath the plant smokestack: pure utility.
notes: No licensed photo. Reference shows long low brick and gabled shop wings with a parking lot and the plant smokestack. Renovation history unknown. Whether the fire station is still Durham-UNH Fire Department's station was not checked.
